title: A password reset the application could not record still signs the account out at the provider
assertion: A reset whose own transaction fails twice queues the provider sign-out alone, through `provider_sign_out_unrecorded_reset` (reason `password_reset_unrecorded`, a reserved action that only this function and the operator's request write), and the line says it did; where the sign-out cannot be queued either, the reset answers as before and the line says not queued
noFileReason: Synthetic accounts and a provider twin the tests make; no file.
